why are we still doing rulings? we replaced that with questions that would show up in my inbox.

and we don't need "Stop says:" hook for the same reason

what was the ruling should now be part of the ticketing or intention recording process. slash sorted should lead to questions, and if i can't answer then right then, for whatever reason, they become open questions in the iunbox. and yes, the answer to the question is the decision... ASSUMING THE ANSWER DOES NOT LEAD TO YET MORE QUESTIONS. If the answer does, we keep going around until you have all the answers you need. so lets make it look like that next.
